newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index up 0.62 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index up 0.62 percent.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index rose 0.43 points, or 0.62 percent, to 69.78 points after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index rose 27.85 points to a provisional 3,138.08.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 12.53 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
